name: Eldritch Recall
body:
Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 15+, dire mantle class feature, 1 rank in Spellcraft

Benefit(s): Keep a list of all spells you have ever successfully identified with Spellcraft. Whenever you encounter any spell on this list you gain a +1 insight bonus to your Spellcraft check to identify it, and may add this bonus to save against the spell if you successfully identify it but choose not to store it in your dire mantle.
